load_mesh_from_file: load a mesh from an OBJ, OFF, or PLY file into a PyTorch3D Meshes object
save_mesh_to_file: save a single PyTorch3D Meshes object to an OBJ, OFF, or PLY file
load_pointcloud_from_file: load a point cloud from a PLY file into a PyTorch3D Pointclouds object
save_pointcloud_to_file: save a single PyTorch3D Pointclouds object to a PLY file
register_custom_mesh_format: register a custom MeshFormatInterpreter to support loading and saving a new mesh file format
